issues.message: The root picture for صَلَاتِهِمْ presents connection to Allah as a root-based lexical association. That devotional explanation may be meaningful, but it is not clearly separated from morphology and can mislead learners about what the root itself encodes.
issues.requiredAction: Replace it with a neutral lexical mnemonic, or explicitly label the connection-to-Allah wording as a devotional/contextual association rather than a root meaning.

evidence.draftText: ص ل و is associated with prayer and connection in ṣalāh; picture an act of prayer connecting the worshipper to Allah.
evidence.learnerRisk: The learner may treat a devotional association as the lexical derivation of the root.
